mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS candidate_id,c.department_id,c.status,c.expires_at,s.purposes,f.version AS snapshot_version,f.facts_json,s.extraction_json FROM ai_hr_source_authorization s JOIN ai_hr_candidate c ON c.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND c.id=s.candidate_id JOIN ai_hr_fact_snapshot f ON f.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND f.candidate_id=c.id AND f.version=1 WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.content_hash=#{hash} AND c.department_id=#{department} AND c.status='ACTIVE' AND c.expires_at>#{now} AND c.id IN #{id} ORDER BY c.acquired_at DESC,c.id,f.id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_hr_source_authorization SET content_hash=#{hash} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND candidate_id=#{candidate} AND (content_hash IS NULL OR content_hash=#{hash})
